text:
maya: Heads-up 1: RetailerX spotlight piece 1: want a 20s quoted line + 8-12m interview clip for the launch post and webinar teaser. Target publish: Jun 9. Available next Tue/Thu mornings?

eli: I can prep the pre-interview brief and 3 caption variants. Morning is best for me.

rachel: We'll need the approved quote for the blog excerpt. Also want a short callout for the benchmark in the sidebar.

omar: Legal needs the signed release before we publish the quote. Also request that any numeric claims be backed by Research or phrased conservatively.

sam: I ran the RetailerX batch last month. Median cost savings = 2.6x vs their prior stack. Happy to publish as "~2.6x" or "nearly 3x" if you include the benchmark doc link and a 1-paragraph methodology.

jess: For inbound routing: webinar RSVPs should go to SFDC campaign "RetailerX Launch Jun" and assign to SDR pool "Retail - North America". Can we set a hidden field for channel and UTM?

maya: Draft quote: "Switching to Redwood gave us nearly 3x lower inference costs and got our team to market faster." Thoughts?

omar: @sam can you upload the CSV + README? If Research posts the backing doc, legal will allow "nearly 3x" but please have the parenthetical link on the blog and the landing page.

sam: Link uploaded: https://drive.redwood/reports/retailerx-benchmark.csv (README in same folder). Methodology: 10k request sample, median per-token cost. I'll paste the short methodology below the fold.

publish-bot: Created intake ticket: asset-14321. Checklist items: schedule recording, signed release, quote approval, attach benchmark link, UTM/SFDC mapping, content handoff.

eli: Social caption options ready; one uses the exact figure and two avoid numbers. If Legal prefers conservative phrasing we can use: "significantly lower inference costs."

omar: With Research doc we can permit the numeric phrasing. I'll attach release template and quick redlines. Need the signed release before the recording.

jess: Ops note: When marketing form posts to SFDC, set CampaignMemberStatus = "Registered" and populate custom fields: utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign. I'll add the mapping to the intake ticket.

maya: Proposed recording slot: Thu 6/1 9:30am PT 1 25-minute block (5m tech check, 20m recording). Who's joining?

eli: I'll run the interview.

rachel: I'll be there to ask feature/distribution questions.

jess: SDR rep standby for lead-handoff notes.

omar: I'll do the release sign-off live if the signed doc appears in the thread before recording.

sam: I'll be on to pull up the benchmark notes if any questions come up.

maya: Great 1 locking time, uploading the pre-interview script and release template to the ticket. Will include the UTM spec and SFDC campaign name. Thanks! :rocket:
